Name: TrainingDummy
Author: qianshan222723
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]TrainingDummy lets you purchase special training dummies and place them on your farm (or anywhere) to safely practice combat. Each swing of your weapon against a dummy grants combat experience, scaled by your weapon's level, with a fully configurable multiplier. No more hunting slimes in the mine just to level up! [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install Generic Mod Config Menu (required to change settings in-game).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download the TrainingDummy mod and unzip it into your 
[/color]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8] folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Four different dummy designs.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Dummies can be bought at Pierre's General Store, the Carpenter's Shop, and the Adventurer's Guild for 40,000g each.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place a dummy on the ground and attack it with any weapon to gain combat experience.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]XP gained per hit is based on your currently equipped weapon's level, multiplied by a configurable rate (default: 1.0x).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Adjust the experience multiplier anytime via Generic Mod Config Menu[/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Generic Mod Config Menu[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to ConcernedApe for creating Stardew Valley, and to the developers of SMAPI and Generic Mod Config Menu for their indispensable tools. Thanks also to the modding community for their endless inspiration and support! [/color]
